name: ip-address-app
description: Demo: difference between binding to 127.0.0.1 vs 0.0.0.0 in Docker

scripts.docker:test: docker compose up --build -d && sleep 2 && echo '--- Testing 0.0.0.0 server (should work) ---' && curl -s http://localhost:3002 | node -e "process.stdin.resume();process.stdin.on('data',d=>console.log(JSON.parse(d)))" && echo '--- Testing 127.0.0.1 server (should fail) ---' && curl -sf http://localhost:3001 || echo 'Connection refused — as expected!' && docker compose down
